trend_filter.condition: average_30d < confirmation_close <= average_30d * 1.10 (completed daily closes, effective that UTC day)

consolidation_breakout.description: A second way in, for when TRX never comes back down to its average: buy the break out of a quiet band.
consolidation_breakout.condition: The 40 bars before the current one sit inside a band no wider than 2% (highest high / lowest low - 1). The first bar to close above that band's top is the break; 3 minutes later the 1-minute close must still be above the top, and the buy lands on the next minute's open. Only the first break of each quiet stretch counts.
consolidation_breakout.market_filter: TRX has no blocked hours and the quiet-band breakout does not use the dip rule's 30-day trend filter, so a break is taken whenever one happens. Requiring an uptrend first screens out exactly the breaks that start one.

exit.note: A break comes out of a quiet band rather than a dip, so it carries its own tighter stop and its own trail.

portfolio.sizing_rule: Every coin that is switched on shares one pot of equal lots, set in the dashboard. A trade buys one full lot when a lot is free and the wallet has the USDT for it; when less than a full lot is left, the buy uses what is left. Money is never set per coin.

provenance.research: Scripts in research/backtests/scripts: run_trx_consolidation_full.py (quiet-band breakout), trx_three_modes.py, trx_selection_test.py (walk-forward). Summary: research/backtests/results/trx_consolidation_families.csv. The large raw grid is regenerated by the script, not stored.
provenance.backtest_bnb_fees: Oct 2024 - Sep 2026 with 3 equal lots; percentages are of the starting money: +74.3% over 239 trades (138 dip, 101 breakout) at a 94.6% win rate, max drawdown -2.99%, six of six walk-forward windows. The earlier rule made +51.6% at -3.07%.
provenance.caveats: The best-supported change of any coin: nothing had to be chosen. The quiet-band breakout improved all six out-of-sample windows at the deployed exit (+21.4% of the money), and keeping the deployed exit and simply adding the breakout earned +63.8% against blind selection's +64.0% - within a fraction of a point, so no setting had to be guessed. A trend exit was tested and rejected: every EMA length made TRX worse, and on the 369 lots that would have switched, the trend line beat the giveback on 25% of them and lost on 70%. An exit retune (arm 3%, giveback 50%) looked better in-sample but its honest contribution was +0.2% and it cost ten points of win rate.
